errors.text: Misinterprets powder-based extrusion printing as high-pressure hot extrusion.
Omits hydrogen de-binding, 1400°C vacuum sintering for 18 hours, and the titanium-sponge oxygen getter.
Attempts to minimize oxygen rather than controlling it near 1.0 wt.% for interstitial strengthening.
Omits the 1500°C water quench required to suppress alpha-HCP and retain metastable beta-BCC.
Introduces unsupported decomposition temperatures, extrusion temperatures, and strain rates.
